title: How Tibo built and sold SaaS for $8M: ship weekly, charge early, build distribution
summary: Tibo Louis-Lucas explains how he shipped a product a week to find product-market fit, validated only by revenue, and sold Tweet Hunter and Taplio for about $8M. He covers a 25% profit-share deal with an influencer, free mini-tools for SEO, buying SaaS for distribution, and starting to build with AI.

principles.text: Validate only with revenue; free users and kind feedback are not product-market fit.
principles.quote: validation is about people paying for the product it's not about free users or people telling you that you have a great idea

principles.text: Ship a product per week for one target and one problem, ideally one you have yourself, to shorten time to product-market fit.
principles.quote: we wanted to shorten the time to product Market fits and so that's how we got into this idea of shipping one product per per week until something stick

principles.text: Ship more: quantity beats quality since you can't predict winners; carve out time weekly for new shots.
principles.quote: increase your shots on goal by carving out at least 20% of your time to just work on new things take new shots

principles.text: Give an influencer a profit share on one product, tied to marketing ownership, to bootstrap distribution; be fully transparent on numbers.
principles.quote: GK would have the marketing ownership and responsibilities of promoting tweet Center he would have to uh actively work on the product and to actively promote it with campaigns referal program and and some other stuff and in exchange he would have 25% of the monthly profit

principles.text: Unbundle product features into free one-page mini tools; they rank on Google and compound as an acquisition channel.
principles.quote: we basically took features of the products and we extracted them and put them in a simple onepage onepage tool

principles.text: As AI makes software cheap to build, value shifts to distribution, so buy SaaS and invest in audience.
principles.quote: it's going to come from your distribution and so that's why I'm I'm also buying s and focusing on distribution myself
